description: This file defines a set of data classes, singleton objects, and functions related to displaying and resolving tool configurations with JSON serialization/deserialization, including caching and fallback mechanisms. It provides functionality to resolve tool display summaries based on context and arguments, using external configuration files.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing action specifications for tool display.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing the display specification for a tool.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Serializable data class representing the overall configuration for tool displays.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, name, arguments, and metadata.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and caches the JSON configuration for tool display specifications.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Converts a tool name into a user-friendly title.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes a verb string by replacing underscores and trimming.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs detail string for read actions based on path and offset.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Gets the first non-empty value from a list of keys in JSON arguments.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Retrieves a value from nested JSON arguments based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement into a string representation with preview/truncation.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces home directory paths in strings with '~'.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement to a String if possible.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Converts a JsonElement to a Double if possible.
